caption: The drawing depicts a single, round-bodied jug with a wide, short neck and a flared rim. It features a prominent handle that is attached from the rim to the upper body of the jug. The jug is rendered in shades of purple, with darker tones concentrated at the base and on the handle, and lighter, lilac hues towards the upper sections of the body and rim. The handle is translucent with the same purple coloration. The background is plain, and the jug is centered on the paper. At the bottom left, there is a small linear scale, and at the bottom right, there is a signature or label with text. The drawing is composed on a beige or off-white background, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Creamer
